citations.quote: My first question is on your guidance. So, you have narrowed both the lower and upper end. Could you help us understand why? Explain the margin performance, the benefit of rupee depreciation, any offset and loss due to deflation, etc.? And did your salary hike also impact your margins in the second half?

citations.title: Q1 FY27 call transcript
citations.quote: Why decide to leave at a time like now, instead of perhaps looking at an extension? I wanted to understand. And with the new CEO coming in, any mandate for the new CEO that you could highlight for us more clearly?

citations.title: Q4 FY26 call transcript
citations.quote: Hi, Salil. Hi, Jayesh. Salil, first on your guidance itself, 1.5% to 3.5%, if you could break up for us, there are a bunch of acquisitions you have made at the end of the quarter.

claim.text: Asked in 8 of 8 calls. Latest: “What keeps FY27 margins above 21% or pushes them below, and how much runway is left on Maximus?”

citations.title: Q2 FY27 call transcript
citations.quote: Great. Good evening and thanks for taking for my question. This quarter, currency and working days contributed about 60 bps while Maximus contributed only 20 bps. With the October and January wage hikes, acquisition amortization and continued pricing pressure hitting the back half, what would keep fiscal '27 margins above the 21% midpoint?

citations.title: Q1 FY27 call transcript
citations.quote: Just wanted to understand, which are some of those parts of the macro that led you to first to increase it between 1.5% to 3.5%, now you sort of cut it down to 3%?

citations.title: Q4 FY26 call transcript
citations.quote: My first question is on the margin sustainability where margins have remained resilient despite multiple headwinds. So, what gives you confidence in sustaining the same going forward?

claim.text: Asked in 7 of 8 calls. Latest: “Asked about headcount growth trends and consolidation deal economics and pricing.?”

citations.quote: I wanted to ask about your thoughts on headcount growth trends through FY27. And I am not looking for specifics, but just generalities.

citations.title: Q4 FY26 call transcript
citations.quote: Good evening. Just a couple of questions. So I just wanted to understand the reason behind the quarterly decline in headcount.

citations.title: Q3 FY26 call transcript
citations.quote: I mean with the AI services picking up, are you internally gearing up for sort of net headcount to start ticking up again?

claim.text: Asked in 4 of 8 calls. Latest: “Asked about TCV vs ACV dynamics and AI deflation quantification.?”

citations.title: Q1 FY27 call transcript
citations.quote: It does look like we have had a pretty decent quarter on deal TCV, net new seems to be decently strong as well as compared to historical levels. But clearly, that is not kind of translating into guidance.

citations.title: Q4 FY26 call transcript
citations.quote: So this quarter we are seeing a sharp contraction or a sequential contraction as far as TCV is concerned. Is that a factor of you know, clients cutting back on your discretionary spending or is it the AI-led deflation that we are seeing this?

citations.title: Q2 FY26 call transcript
citations.quote: Could I get you to throw some light on what those specific deals are like? What is the AI order book shaping up to be at this point in time?

claim.text: Asked in 2 of 8 calls. Latest: “What is the nature of work in the net new mega deal, and does it involve asset/people takeovers?”

citations.title: Q2 FY27 call transcript
citations.quote: Yes. Hi, good evening. Could you just talk a bit about the nature of work in this net new mega deal? And does it also have any margin implications during the ramp up phase? Thanks.

citations.title: Q2 FY26 call transcript
citations.quote: Can you comment on what you are seeing in some of the smaller deal activity? Any changes there versus the prior quarter? And then just on the signings, so the TCV has been healthy now for 2 quarters. Can you comment on just how ACV levels in new work that you are booking may be trending?
